body:
READ-ONLY ESTIMAND AUDIT COMPLETE for bd-01M15ZHMHXNMNMHXHK8EZ56SSY. No claims, reservations, or edits. VERDICT: the new AGENTS.md estimand rule is worded exactly right; I recommend no change. Applying it across the interview scoring surface found five executable P1 candidates plus two source-traced siblings. Chief owns disposition and decomposition.

1. RepetitionRule.Ignore renormalizes absence into certainty. Scoring.scala:121-147 drops repetition pairs, then Distribution.of normalizes the residue. Live probe: address = 0.5 Repetition + 0.5 GeneralKnowledge produced REP=Some(Vector((ExternalSemantic,1.0))). InterviewSuite.scala:891-904 currently asserts that promotion. Estimand changed from 0.5 retained semantic mass to P(semantic | not ignored)=1 without carrying the condition. Required shape: retained subprobability plus ignored mass; never a normalized Distribution alone after exclusion.

2. Profile membership turns placement uncertainty into substantive participant zeros with full coverage. Scoring.scala:243-246, 400-406, 443-465 thresholds every unit class at >=0.5, while unit coverage at 520-523 means only that an assessment exists. Live pure-Unresolved single-unit probe returned episodicDensityPerWord=Observed(0.0)/Coverage(1,1), semanticization=0/1-of-1, otherEventDrift=0/1-of-1, redundancy=0/1-of-1; eventPurity was Missing but still Coverage(1,1). Thus model abstention is published as certain absence of target, semantic, other-event, and repetition content. At 0.6 target/0.4 unresolved it becomes one full target unit; at 0.4/0.6 it becomes zero. The same threshold governs density, purity, anchoring, perceptual/mental profiles, graph metrics, and probe gain. Integer Coverage cannot express placement-resolution mass. Required shape: a distinct typed fractional placement summary at the relevant unit/situation/phase grain, with subprobability/bounds or abstention.

3. Both hard-count rules manufacture quantity or certainty. ExpectedRounded independently rounds categories at Scoring.scala:188-190. Live one-detail 0.5 Event + 0.5 Place probe: expected=(0.5,0.5), hard=(1,1), hard total=2. A one-detail three-way 1/3 split conversely rounds to total 0. ArgmaxAddress at 191-196 ignores expected-count mass and entropy; live expectedCountMass=0.2 gave expectedInternal=0.2 but one hard InternalEvent. Distribution.mode breaks ties by rendered name at assess.scala:81-85. Hard scores need their own abstention/margin and classification coverage; total hard quantity cannot be independently rounded category marginals.

4. Missing count mass becomes a falsely tight zero. rows at 149-159 omit Missing, then expectedCounts at 167-178 initializes every omitted category to point=0 and interval=[0,0]. Live all-Missing single-detail probe: Coverage(1,0), every ExpectedCount=0/[0,0], hard total=0. Global coverage exists, but the numeric interval itself asserts no possible count; byPhase at 197-202 has no phase-specific coverage at all. If provider failure differs by phase or subject difficulty, apparent count/probe differences follow. Required shape: partial-total bounds or abstention in which unobserved count mass widens possible totals, and coverage travels at each phase.

5. Graph profile metrics inherit the same hard threshold as a structural finding. targetAs at 465 filters assessments before target nodes and relation edges are formed at 506-518. A relation at target mass 0.49 disappears while target-node assessments at 0.51 remain; fragmentation rises and relationalIntegration falls. sitEligible/observed then counts only threshold survivors, not excluded placement mass. Uncertain relation placement correlated with disorganisation therefore becomes participant fragmentation. Required shape: soft/subprobability graph participation or explicit relation-placement abstention/bounds and coverage.

6. Per-second density silently conditions on recorded turns. profile(model) at 545-559 sums audio duration only from participant turns having Some(audio), but its numerator includes target units from all assessed turns and it publishes no audio-turn/time coverage. Partial audio shrinks the denominator and inflates density. This can create site/group differences from recording missingness. Require complete participant audio or name the conditional estimand and carry audio coverage/bounds.

7. Probe gain coverage is not observation coverage. At 304-318 observed is free+post TARGET-classified units, so confidently non-target and unresolved assessed units both lower coverage; uncertainty and substantive non-target recall are conflated. By-phase target membership still uses the same 0.5 discontinuity. It needs assessed-unit and placement-resolution coverage per phase, separate from the conditional target-share denominator.

SURFACES THAT SURVIVED THIS PASS: targetMass is an expected target atom-mass sum and travels with massCoverage; current phenomenology correctly collapses by source unit, carries assessed-unit Coverage, passes explicit reliving through, and does not multiply with atomization. Remaining representation caveat: firstPersonLanguage is Boolean and source-monitoring absence is an empty set, so the assessment layer has no Unknown for either cue; scoring can only treat absence as false. The already assigned specificity/contributor receipt gap is not duplicated here.

GENERAL LAW suggested by all findings: exclusion or abstention yields a subprobability plus named missing/ignored mass; classification-derived scores carry placement-resolution evidence at their own grain; hard outputs abstain rather than invent units; denominators disclose their observation support. A score and its coverage/condition must be non-separable in the public type.
